# MailBluster

MailBluster is an advanced, reliable, and cost-effective email marketing software that enables sending personalized promotional emails to millions.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailbluster/.

## Actions

- **Create MailBluster Lead**: Create a new lead in mailbluster.
- **Create Order**: Create a new order in mailbluster.
- **Create Product**: Create a new product in mailbluster.
- **Delete Mailbluster Product**: Delete a product.
- **Delete Order**: Delete a specific order.
- **Get Order** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific order.
- **Get Product** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific product.
- **List Fields** (read-only): List all custom fields.
- **List Orders** (read-only): List all orders.
- **List Products** (read-only): List all products.
- **MailBluster Update Product**: Update a product in mailbluster by its id.
